landing.title: SportsHawk has separate spaces for players and coaches.
landing.subtitle: These are separate account roles with different onboarding, home screens, navigation, and product access.
landing.playerSub: Train daily, upload drills, earn points and coins, qualify for assessments, and appear on player leaderboards.
landing.coachSub: Discover talent through protected scout previews, unlock profiles with coins, and contact players only through SportsHawk.
landing.roleBoundariesTitle: Role boundaries are enforced in the UI.
landing.roleBoundariesBody: Player accounts cannot access scout dashboards. Coach accounts do not upload drills or appear on player leaderboards.
landing.resetComplete: SportsHawk has been reset. You can choose a fresh account type now.
landing.lockedTitle: Your SportsHawk account is registered as {{role}} account.
landing.lockedBody: Role selection is permanent after account creation. To change from Player to Coach, or Coach to Player, contact SportsHawk support for identity and eligibility review.

onboarding.playerHeading: Build a development trail from day one.
onboarding.playerBody: SportsHawk starts every footballer with a verified profile, then connects daily practice habits to gamified progress and physical assessment center readiness.
onboarding.playerCardSub: First profile for daily habit tracking.
onboarding.assessmentReadyBody: This profile can later connect daily streaks, coach notes, skill badges, and verified testing events.
onboarding.createPlayerBody: Capture the essentials scouts and coaches need before habits, challenges, and physical testing begin.
onboarding.rolePermanentPlayer: Player role selection is permanent after signup. Changing to a Coach account requires contacting SportsHawk support.
onboarding.coachHeading: Create a coach and scout workspace.
onboarding.coachBody: Coach accounts are built for talent discovery, protected profile unlocks, and internal SportsHawk messaging.
onboarding.coachPermanent: Coach role selection is permanent after signup. Changing to a Player account requires contacting SportsHawk support.
onboarding.coachAccountBody: This account will not appear on player leaderboards and cannot upload drill scores.
onboarding.coachVerificationBody: After selecting your role, submit your AIFF Coaching License ID and certificate photo. Your account starts as Pending Verification.
onboarding.protectedScoutingBody: Player contact requests stay inside SportsHawk messaging.
onboarding.playerSignupBlocked: This device already has a Coach account. SportsHawk account roles are permanent after creation, so coach accounts cannot create player profiles or upload drills without contacting support.
onboarding.coachSignupBlocked: This device already has a Player account. SportsHawk role selection is permanent after account creation, so player accounts cannot create coach or scout profiles without contacting support.

subscriptionUpsell.heading: See what Pro and Elite unlock
subscriptionUpsell.body: Upgrade paths are built around better training feedback, faster coin earning, and stronger assessment visibility.
subscriptionUpsell.proSummary: For players who want fitness drills, wearable metrics, and faster rewards.
subscriptionUpsell.proWearables: Wearable metrics for load, recovery, and heart-rate tracking
subscriptionUpsell.proCoins: Earn coins at 2x speed on drill uploads and streaks
subscriptionUpsell.proQueue: Elevated assessment queue and more store rewards
subscriptionUpsell.eliteSummary: For serious trial-ready players who want the richest AI scoring layer.
subscriptionUpsell.eliteCombo: Combo detection across multi-surface and linked-skill drills
subscriptionUpsell.eliteSkill: Skill differentiation bonuses for advanced technique quality
subscriptionUpsell.eliteCoins: Earn coins at 3x speed across training activity
subscriptionUpsell.elitePriority: Priority assessment path and Elite visibility signals

home.nextLayer: The next product layer can add habit check-ins, local leaderboard points, coach review badges, and assessment center booking.

drills.title: Drill Library
drills.heading: Train the habit, earn the points.
drills.subtitle: Pick a short drill, complete the session, and keep the daily development streak moving.
drills.analyzingBody: SportsHawk AI is estimating rep count, rhythm, and control quality from the smartphone recording.
drills.readyBody: Tap Start once the full body and ball are visible within 30m.
drills.faceUnlockBody: Authenticate on the capture panel before starting this drill.
drills.recordingBody: Keep the player fully in frame while SportsHawk captures reps and rhythm.
drills.captureUnavailable: This drill is unavailable for smartphone capture.
drills.depthRule: SportsHawk only supports drills that can be recorded cleanly within a 30m visual depth.
drills.scoringSoonBody: This drill will use the same face unlock, tripod framing, 5-second out-of-frame reauthentication, and 30m depth rules before capture.

assessment.title: Assessment Center
assessment.heading: Earn your verified physical test.
assessment.subtitle: Qualify over a 90-day window with enough sessions, category range, and a proven training streak.
assessment.mapSubtitle: Static coverage view for verified assessment cities.
assessment.mapAlt: India map showing SportsHawk assessment centers in Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, Kolkata, and Bhubaneswar
assessment.unlockedBody: The player has met all qualifying criteria for a free assessment slot.
assessment.progressBody: {{name}} has completed {{completed}}/3 criteria toward a free assessment.
assessment.windowNote: Sessions older than this window do not count toward assessment unlock.

criteria.sessionsDescription: Complete 45 qualifying sessions inside the 90-day window.
criteria.categoriesDescription: Show range across at least 3 drill categories.
criteria.streakDescription: Maintain at least one 14-day training streak.

schedule.title: Schedule free assessment
schedule.body: Choose one preferred SportsHawk center and session slot. Each unlocked player can schedule one free assessment session.
